_comment: Stage definitions for the Research Director (/research-pipeline). Read by scripts/orchestrator.py and hooks/orchestrator_guard.py. 'agents' = project Agents that may be dispatched in that stage (an agent may be dispatched in its own stage or any later stage, never earlier). 'min_artifacts' = artifacts that must be registered (and non-empty) before the gate can pass. 'require_name' / 'require_text' are regexes (case-insensitive) that some artifact path / the artifacts' text must match. 'checks' = named mechanical checks run by verify (see scripts/paper_tools.py stage_check): citations_resolved, citations_verified, results_linked, claims_aligned, no_open_questions.

stages.name: 问题
stages.gate: 研究问题、estimand 与可行性是否确定？

stages.name: 文献
stages.gate: 文献争论簇、精确缺口与未核实清单是否完整？

stages.name: 机制
stages.gate: 竞争性假说能否由机制推出？制度/法源与政策冲击时点是否核实？

stages.name: 设计
stages.gate: 识别假设与威胁—检验矩阵是否可辩护？分析计划与因果措辞上限是否冻结？

stages.name: 执行
stages.gate: 是否按计划执行、记录偏离，并把核心结果登记入 Meta/results-ledger.json？

stages.name: 独立审查
stages.gate: 独立审查意见（含框架锁定与 7 类 AI 失效模式核查）是否完整汇报？

stages.name: 决定
stages.gate: 致命问题是否已解决？接受进入写作 / 退回 / 停止

stages.name: 论文大纲
stages.gate: C1：论证脊柱、主张清单、6 步引言蓝图与文献/图表布局是否确定？

stages.name: 引文
stages.gate: C2：引文表核验状态与三层定位锚点（locator）是否可接受？

stages.name: 成稿
stages.gate: C3：主张—证据对照、主张覆盖度与经济量级表述是否准确？

stages.name: 精修与润色
stages.gate: C4：精修结果、剩余问题与可选语言润色（polish check 通过）是否可接受？

stages.name: 终检
stages.gate: C5：投稿前清单（含 7 类失效清零、AI 披露与知识库回流）是否完成？
